data.description: The 5 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide is a red and yellow enclosed tube that spirals down from a steel tower. Children climb the tower, step into the tunnel and disappear from view for a moment before they come out at the bottom. The enclosed tube keeps children inside the slide all the way round, and the hidden ride is a big draw for the 5 ft age group. It needs less ground than a straight tunnel slide, so it suits compact play areas in schools and societies. The tower and tube come with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the tower, tunnel and exit.

items.pText: The 5 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide is a red and yellow enclosed tube that spirals down from a steel tower. Children climb the tower, step into the tunnel and disappear from view for a moment before they come out at the bottom. The enclosed tube keeps children inside the slide all the way round, and the hidden ride is a big draw for the 5 ft age group. It needs less ground than a straight tunnel slide, so it suits compact play areas in schools and societies. The tower and tube come with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the tower, tunnel and exit.

The tower is galvanised steel and the spiral tunnel is a weather-proof moulding. It can stand on its own base or be grouted in. Adults cannot see inside the tube, so place the exit where supervisors can watch it, keep a soft surface there, and check the tunnel joints during maintenance.
